author: @kizunoV
text:
Ghelot has ~75x str scaling (including the bleed damage) doing a 5 flail combo exalt, kath str scaling is fairly straightforward - it depends on fiamma/arith.  Glotan it's pretty clear you have 10x str per long blade, 25 for exalt, for for OE multiplied by final damage multiplier and 4 for glotan. This is all of course multiplied by crit multi. Base damage would heavily factor in obviously but this is just according to damage growth based on str.

AA 3 stack OE GLotan > Ghelot > OE GLotan > Kath in str scaling, but factoring base damage would change things because kath gets lots of base damage scaling too.
video_title: [Morimens] Who is the Strongest Str Scaler in Game? A comparison of every STR Scalers burst turn.
